name: claude-multi-account
description: claude-multi-account for macOS and for Windows: install the plugin for your OS.

plugins.name: claude-multi-account-macos
plugins.description: macOS: per-account profiles, a usage table across all of them, one-shot prompts as another account, and swapping which account VS Code and the claude CLI use.

plugins.name: claude-multi-account-windows
plugins.description: Windows (PowerShell and Git Bash): per-account profiles, a usage table across all of them, one-shot prompts as another account, and swapping which account VS Code and the claude CLI use.
